conflicts.permit: We include a third party ad service that can access some amount of information about you from your device for the purpose of delivering targeted ads.
conflicts.prohibit: No personal information is retained by the Docs To Go client apps and no personal information is communicated back to DataViz’s servers.
conflicts.situation: When using ad-supported versions of Docs To Go and the third-party ad service accesses information from the user's device.
conflicts.reason: The policy asserts that no personal information is retained or communicated, yet simultaneously notes a third-party ad service can access user information from the device.
